seo.description: Industrial oxygen gas and cylinders for metal cutting, welding, and fabrication. Manufactured and supplied from Nagpur across Central India.

faq.question: What oxygen cylinder sizes do you supply?
faq.answer: Compressed oxygen cylinders in 10L, 20L, and 47L sizes, with liquid and bulk/manifold supply available on request.

faq.question: What purity is industrial oxygen?
faq.answer: Industrial grade oxygen at 99.2% purity, and 99.999% ultra-high-purity (UHP) oxygen through our specialty gases range.

faq.question: Do you deliver oxygen cylinders in Nagpur?
faq.answer: Yes. We deliver across Nagpur and nearby areas including Kamptee, Hingna, and Kalmeshwar. We are open 24 hours, 7 days a week.
